about.title: Who I am
about.paragraph1: I'm a Full-Stack Developer currently studying Computer Science at UniRitter. My journey started in 2024 with a technical degree in IT and an internship at the company I still work for today. Since January 2025, I've been working there as a junior developer.
about.paragraph2: Day to day I work with Python, Django, HTML5, CSS3 and vanilla JavaScript, along with libraries like Bootstrap, Reportlab, Chart.js and FullCalendar. I'm currently diving deeper into Django REST Framework, with Vue.js as my next step.
